title: Evaluating Vision Language Model Adaptations for Radiology Report Generation in Low-Resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on radiology report generation across a high-resource language (English) and low-resource languages (Italian, German, and Spanish) using NLP metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR to assess the performance gap caused by English-centric pre-training data.
